bends.note: Loth comes in from the top of the drawn area running SE (dx/dy ~+0.67, 50 ft), turns here to SSE (dx/dy ~+0.34) and narrows to 40 ft (same angle point as sheet 169's 50'/40' change); at the St. Joe crossing it turns again to due south and runs straight to Mulberry
Vine runs SSE (dx/dy ~+0.31) from the top of the drawn area past St. Joe to here, then due south
Vine turns from due south to SSE (dx/dy ~+0.44) just north of Mulberry and continues past it onto sheet 161

notes: Mt Auburn, Vine Street (west, 'SEE VOLUME THREE' beyond) to Rice (east), Mulberry along the bottom; the top of the drawn area overlaps the bottom of sheet 169 (rotated ~34 deg relative to it). Names printed bare (LOTH, RICE, GAGE, WINKLER, MULBERRY; VINE); 'Street' added to match sheets 161/169/171. The middle street is printed on a paste as 'ST. JOE (EVANS)' (30', 'EVANS' also on the house numbers); named St. Joe Street here ('St.' = Saint), formerly Evans. St. Joe runs from Vine (T, Vine's west line continuous) east to Loth (T): Loth bends from SSE to due south exactly at the crossing, so the point is on both legs. East of Loth only a 10 ft strip continues, offset to the south half of St. Joe's line (centre y~1755 vs St. Joe ~1717), to Rice; listed as an unnamed 10 ft alley. Alleys: the 20 ft alley from sheet 169 enters at the top, turns at ~(1356,566) where it is printed 16', and ends at St. Joe's north side; the unnamed 10 ft alley printed 'ALLEY' starts at St. Joe's south side ~45 px further east and runs to Mulberry (so the two do not form a crossing). The 15 ft alley from sheet 169 (east of Loth) runs SSE to the 10 ft strip at ~(2597,1755), where WENDEL ALLEY (printed 'WENDEL' and 'ALLEY', 10' at Mulberry) begins and runs due south to Mulberry; the 15 ft alley may be Wendel's upper part but is not labelled. Rice/Gage: Rice comes in from the NW as a 40 ft diagonal and turns due south at Gage, which leaves east; this is a wide Y junction, so (as on sheets 169 and 171) one point is given in the open junction on Gage's centreline, about 70% of the way from the diagonal leg's centreline (2849,488) toward the vertical leg's centreline (2976,488); Rice's centre vertex itself would be at ~(2976,676). Winkler ('WINKLER') leaves Rice's east side (T). Mulberry (70', 6 in. pipe) has Vine, the unnamed alley (x~1802), Loth, Wendel Alley and Rice all ending at its north side; its south side is continuous except a 10 ft stairway opposite Rice (sheet 161). Vine/Mulberry is a T: west of Vine is volume 3 and Vine's west line is continuous; Vine is already on its SSE leg at Mulberry (centre taken ~115 px east of its west line, matching the 10 in. pipe).
